findings.title: Validation error message leaks raw input
findings.body: The error message on line 8 includes the raw input `raw` in the exception text, which could expose sensitive data (e.g., passwords, tokens) if the address is malformed. Use the cleaned value `cleaned` in the message instead.

findings.title: Redundant validation variable
findings.body: The variable `cleaned` is assigned on line 6 but only used once on line 7. The validation logic can be inlined to improve readability without sacrificing clarity.

summary.problem: The email normalization function now validates addresses but leaks raw input in error messages and introduces a redundant variable.
summary.done_well: The new validation ensures only syntactically valid email addresses are accepted, improving data integrity.
